# Q3 2026 Internal Management Financial Summary
**Division:** Industrial Energy Systems
**Period:** Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
**Prepared by:** Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

## 1. Executive Summary
The division recorded solid commercial activity during the third quarter. Gross revenues advanced to $18,450,000 against a target budget of $18,000,000. Operating gross margins stood at 39.3% ($7,250,000). Total operating income before tax reached $1,350,000.

## 3. Notable Project Notes
- Project Titan Milestone 2 was billed on September 28 for $850,000 and recognized in full under Gross Revenue.
- Prototype testing for Turbines Series-7 ($250,000) was capitalized as work-in-progress R&D asset.
- COGS includes standard production costs but leaves logistics accruals to year-end true-up.
